Container.Name: Ledgerly
Container.Overview:
Ledgerly is a self-hosted personal finance app. Track bills with expected and "up to" amounts, due dates and the account each one is paid from; see the projected running balance of those accounts and when they would dip low or go negative; track income; and follow loan balances with full amortization tables, including extra principal payments. Manage payees (with links to their websites) and categories.
Multiple people can use one install, and each user's data is private. The first account you create becomes the admin, who can close sign-ups and set up email for password resets. Sample data can be explored and deleted without touching your own.
Everything is stored in the appdata folders below. Keep the keys folder with the data folder: it holds the encryption keys for sign-ins and the saved email password. To reach Ledgerly from outside your network, put it behind a reverse proxy with HTTPS and set "Behind a reverse proxy" to true.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: finance budget bills money loans amortization mortgage expenses

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the Ledgerly web interface.

Config.Name: Keys
Config.Description: Encryption keys for sign-ins and the saved email password. Back these up with the data.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID Ledgerly runs as. It owns the data and keys folders.

Config.Name: Money and date format
Config.Description: Culture used to format money and dates, e.g. en-US, en-GB, de-DE.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to true when a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik) handles HTTPS in front of Ledgerly.
